payload.scope:
i8c takes on:
- A top-middle board toolbar: a greyed book placeholder (until i6) + an active phone-connect icon.
- The connect action: clicking phone-connect generates the ntfy topic pair, writes ~/.se/<project>/phone.json (enabled), and renders a QR in the details pane, encoded LOCALLY.
- A correct local QR encoder (vendored or hand-rolled per se.adr-install-over-zerodep).
All against the existing i8 bless mechanics, unchanged. Runs in i8c's worktree, blessed on the board.
payload.non_goals:
- The book itself + its open action (i6; the icon ships greyed).
- Other toolbar icons (future, per feature).
- Non-ntfy channels.
- The i8 bless mechanics (unchanged).
- QR decoding / the inbound side (the phone app subscribes; we only ENCODE).
- Live owner-physical pairing (se.raid-phone-live-pairing).
